title: The Physical Examination of the Throwing Shoulder.

sections.label: UNLABELED
sections.text: In the first part of this 2 part series, we describe the comprehensive evaluation of the overhead throwing athlete's shoulder. The physical examination of the throwing shoulder requires a comprehensive knowledge and familiarity with anatomy, kinesiology, pathology, and unique sporting demands. The history, systematic basic examination, and special testing of the rotator cuff, biceps and superior labrum anterior and posterior lesions, instability and labral pathology, and scapular dyskinesia will be covered in this review.
